Agent Chat Lifecycle
|-- AgentChatService owns conversations and coordinates the lifecycle
|   |-- Create -> thread/start -> persist session -> index chat ID <-> thread ID
|   |   `-- Capture settings and tool definitions; register MCP configuration
|   |-- Import existing Codex thread -> thread/resume
|   |   |-- Coalesce concurrent imports; return an already imported session
|   |   |-- Preserve native instructions, tools, working directory and model
|   |   `-- Reject an active thread; import transcript with unfinished items interrupted
|   |-- FileChatStore persists sessions under agent-chat/<id>.json
|   |   `-- Serialize saves -> write mode-0600 temporary file -> rename into place
|   |-- Restore after server restart
|   |   |-- Clear pending questions and activity; interrupt unfinished items/turns
|   |   `-- Mark unfinished generations failed; require a new generation to retry
|   `-- Background conversations
|       `-- Start with feature-owned instructions and injected context; omit from chat list
|-- Send or Read Canvas -> one managed turn
|   |-- Deduplication and exclusion
|   |   |-- Previously recorded requestId -> return without another turn
|   |   `-- Running, starting or reloading conversation -> conflict
|   |-- Mark running; apply requested model, effort and sandbox settings
|   |-- Read Canvas additionally captures complete short canvas context
|   |   `-- Supply it as read_canvas tool output to turn/start
|   |-- Resume thread when needed
|   |   `-- Restore MCP configuration; retain native Codex instructions on imported threads
|   |-- Capture canvas target + selected references for this turn
|   |   `-- Bind MCP access to that canvas and the turn's read-only setting
|   |-- Record requestId and save session BEFORE turn/start
|   |   `-- A retried HTTP request cannot issue the recorded turn again
|   |-- turn/start sends text + captured references, or the Read Canvas tool output
|   |   `-- A fast completion may arrive before the start RPC response
|   |-- Start failure -> clear MCP binding -> mark failed -> persist
|   `-- Interrupt -> cancel active generation children -> wait for start -> turn/interrupt
|-- Canvas tool access uses the captured turn context
|   |-- Native item/tool/call or HTTP /tools/<name> with binding token + call ID
|   |   |-- Require enabled canvas tools, a known tool and an active turn
|   |   |-- Native calls also check turn identity; bound HTTP calls reject reload overlap
|   |   `-- Clone settings + canvas context + tool-call identity before dispatch
|   |-- gen-alternatives -> generation lifecycle below
|   |-- ChatDiagramTools -> AgentDiagrammingSessionService [agent_access]
|   |   |-- Attach to captured canvas; resolve explicit node IDs or selected references
|   |   |-- Edit/create/extend -> prepare one-document batch -> submitDirect
|   |   |   |-- Validate current diagram identity, base revision and subtree boundaries
|   |   |   `-- Track edit-run ownership; status/cancel must belong to this conversation
|   |   |-- Context, highlights, projections and saved-view operations reuse canvas access
|   |   |-- Mutations require Workspace access
|   |   `-- Cache prepared requests by conversation + request/call identity
|   |       |-- Same identity + same arguments -> reuse prepared operation
|   |       `-- Same identity + different arguments -> REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT
|   `-- Reload tools only while no turn is running or starting
|       `-- Unsubscribe/resume -> refresh MCP -> verify inventory -> save new definitions
|           `-- Keep thread history; direct subsequent calls to current chat_* MCP tools
|-- Incoming RPC events -> session state and browser stream
|   |-- Route by thread ID; reject requests for unknown threads
|   |-- Transcript, plan, activity and token-usage updates -> reduceChatEvent -> listeners
|   |   `-- Coalesce adjacent text deltas; flush after 32 ms or a large buffered burst
|   |-- Questions and approvals
|   |   |-- Retain application request ID -> wire ID + original parameters
|   |   |-- Publish pending input, command/file approval or permission request
|   |   |-- Answer -> validate -> respond on original wire ID -> record interaction -> save
|   |   |   `-- Mask secret answers in transcript; permission grants have turn scope
|   |   `-- Server resolution or turn end -> remove pending request and record its outcome
|   |-- turn/completed
|   |   |-- Flush deltas; settle unfinished items and unresolved interactions
|   |   |-- completed -> idle; interrupted -> interrupted; other terminal result -> failed
|   |   `-- Clear pending/activity -> persist -> finish generation when this is a child
|   `-- agentChatRoutes exposes sessions, actions, tools and SSE
|       |-- Subscribe -> current snapshot -> subsequent events
|       |-- Hide tool definitions, generation request receipts and generation history
|       |-- Split multi-item snapshots; shorten large finished tool details
|       |   `-- Full individual items remain available through the item endpoint
|       `-- 15-second heartbeat; bound extra backlog to 2 MiB beyond snapshot allowance
|           `-- Disconnect -> clear heartbeat and unsubscribe listener
|-- Alternative generation -> isolated child chats and canvases
|   |-- Preconditions
|   |   `-- Parent chat, Workspace access, tools/MCP/bridge, prior user message and source canvas
|   |-- Deduplicate by parent + requestId; compare input/source signature
|   |   `-- Reuse saved receipt or error; conflicting arguments fail
|   |-- Prepare run
|   |   |-- Optionally read saved AgentContext [contexts]; retain its ID and content hash
|   |   |-- Persist queued child sessions and parent receipt
|   |   `-- Start source candidate views with expectedVersion -> capture source history
|   |       `-- Save each child's input history for later replay
|   |-- Launch candidates concurrently; each owns a distinct thread, binding and controller
|   |   |-- With saved context -> new thread -> inject captured context as reference material
|   |   |-- Without saved context -> fork parent at the captured turn boundary
|   |   |-- Clear inherited goal so the candidate remains one managed turn
|   |   `-- Bind isolated canvas -> mark generating -> start candidate prompt
|   |-- GenerationCanvasBridge owns MappingDocumentController instances [canvas_commands]
|   |   |-- Construct each from captured history with a fresh context ID
|   |   |-- Expose canvas reads, snapshots and supported controller mutations
|   |   |-- Serialize commands per candidate; enforce document binding
|   |   |-- Mutation requestId + command signature -> cached receipt or conflict
|   |   |   `-- Apply version/revision checks -> export history -> persist child history
|   |   `-- Ordinary canvas IDs delegate to live bridge; expired generation IDs fail
|   |       `-- Candidate edits leave the live source content and browser selection unchanged
|   |-- Settle once per child
|   |   |-- Idle -> finished; interrupted/explicit cancellation -> cancelled; otherwise failed
|   |   |-- Retain history, duration and usage excluding inherited fork history
|   |   |-- Update source candidate view; include result history only when finished
|   |   |-- Save failure -> retain result; retry publication when generations are queried
|   |   `-- Clear binding -> remove isolated controller -> unsubscribe child thread
|   `-- Retained generated chats are for review
|       `-- Iterate with a new generation; reruns reuse captured input history and settings
`-- StdioCodexConnection owns external process and RPC lifetime
    |-- First request -> require AI enabled -> spawn codex app-server --listen stdio://
    |   |-- Share one startup promise; apply process-local compaction overrides
    |   `-- initialize -> initialized -> accept requests
    |-- Newline-delimited JSON over stdio
    |   |-- Numbered request -> pending promise + 30-second timeout
    |   |-- Response -> resolve/reject promise and clear timer
    |   `-- Server method -> notify subscribers; respond/reject handles server requests
    |-- Process/input failure
    |   |-- Reset process/startup state; reject all pending RPCs; notify service
    |   `-- Service clears resumed threads, requests and bindings
    |       `-- Flush/settle active work -> mark failed -> persist and settle generations
    `-- Service disposal
        `-- Interrupt active chats; fail unfinished generations; persist and flush
            `-- Clear bindings -> unsubscribe connection listener -> kill child process
